resources.string: When you sleep, your brain cycles through loops. One full loop takes about 90 minutes and is called a sleep cycle
A full, refreshing night typically includes 4 to 6 cycles, which adds up to 6 to 9 hours of sleep
Waking up between cycles feels natural and refreshing. Waking up during one causes that heavy, disoriented feeling known as sleep inertia
Cyclo helps you avoid that by finding the best times to fall asleep or wake up, always aligned with the end of a cycle
What time do you want to wake up?
